title: The Whorl
spine: the spiral (Ori's Sunken Glades, WotW's Inkwater Marsh)
legend: Grid in screens, x across, y down. items: 'currency' = a lamp to snuff (its freed moths count toward completion); 'key' = a moon-drop (doors count the drops she holds; none are spent); 'health' = a heart-seed; 'energy' = a glow shard. 'oneway' a -> b only. 'shortcut' opens from b.

rooms.name: The Hatching
rooms.note: A crack in the foot of the dead beech. Split cocoons; Tatter. Through the crack at second 10, far east over the canopy, the Steeple's crown glows with false light (the goal, seen). Within reach: the floor knot with two empty cups (keys:2, the first lock), a crack up into the sibling husks (claws), leaves to cut, the way up into the Nave.

rooms.name: The Nave
rooms.note: HUB. The beech's hollow: heartwood ribs 5 screens tall, one knothole high in the vault (the Rose) with the real moon in it, and under it the firefly's chandelier (wicks and two lanterns on root chains) with moths circling it instead of the moon. A moss bed bench on the floor. Seven ways: the Hatching, the Rootfall (W, low), the Triforium ledge (W, high: claws), the Rood Loft (claws up the ribs), the East Stair (E, low), the East Gallery's broken limb across the vault (glide), the Rose (glide). Within reach: the bench, a juvenile beetle on the floor, a wick at the foot of the ribs, the chandelier to fling off. It grows each return: pass 2 (from above) her freed moths sit on the ribs in rows of glinting eyes and a dangler hangs from the chandelier over the bench; pass 5 (after glide) the firefly has added a second ring of lights and a hawker hunts the vault; after the Weaver the chandelier is dark and the moonlight falls to the floor.

rooms.name: The Sibling Husks
rooms.note: Dead end. A crack above the Hatching, too high to reach until claws: her siblings' empty cocoons, and a heart-seed in the last one. Seen from second 1. Within reach: the heart-seed, a wick that lights the cocoons, leaves.

rooms.name: The Rood Loft
rooms.note: Dead end. A ledge high on the Nave's west ribs, seen from the floor on the first visit: kick up the ribs with claws. A moon-drop in a knot cup. Within reach: the drop, a dangler on the ledge, a drop back onto the chandelier (a fling across the vault).

rooms.name: The Rose
rooms.note: The knothole at the top of the vault, the real moon framed in it. Reached by gliding off the chandelier's ring after snuffing it, or later dropping in from the High Canopy. A moon-drop in the moonlight. Within reach: the drop, the chandelier's top lantern (2 hits), the view down the whole Nave, the way up onto the canopy.

rooms.name: The Rootfall
rooms.note: Shaft. Roots pour down the beech's west side like a waterfall, wet and slick: nothing climbs it, ever (kick-proof faces). A run of ledges down past a wick and two leaf curtains, then the drop into the Sump. Within reach: a wick over a ledge (a fling to the Beetle Run), leaves, the moth-stone crawl (claws), the drop.

rooms.name: The Beetle Run
rooms.note: Long hall west off the Rootfall: the first fight. Two juvenile beetles on a root floor, a wick between them over a short gap (the first catch and snuff). Within reach: the beetles, the wick, the Wick Garden above, the warren's mouth below, and at its west end the West Chimney's thorny foot (claws, seen).

rooms.name: The Beetle Warren
rooms.note: Dead end under the Beetle Run: the beetles' nest, three juveniles and a burrback that wakes when she drops in, rolling a heart-seed. Within reach: the fight, the heart-seed, a pogo line off the burrback's shell to a high ledge.

rooms.name: The Wick Garden
rooms.note: Glow-caps the firefly has lit: four wicks at different heights, a fling chain between them. The Triforium's ledge is just above (claws). Within reach: four wicks (a 20-moth cloud), a dangler over the middle cap, the moth-stone, the Triforium ledge.

rooms.name: The Moth-stone
rooms.note: A stone carved long ago with the moths' road: the wood, the valley, the mountain, the moon over it. A glow shard in its cup. With claws a crawl through to the Rootfall's top makes a small loop. Within reach: the carving, the shard, a wick at the crawl.

rooms.name: The Sump
rooms.note: Long hall: black water under the roots, lit only where moonlight leaks. The Rootfall dumps her in at the east end; the only way out is up the West Chimney (claws). Dead moths floating under a dead lantern (the stakes). Within reach: a burrback on the far bank, the Husk Hollow, the Old Burrow, the Moss Bed, the chimney's foot.

rooms.name: The Husk Hollow
rooms.note: Dead end at the far low end of the west: an old moth's shed husk clinging to the wall; she takes its hooks. CLAWS. The room's only way on is the chimney, one wall-kick away. Within reach: the claws, the chimney (the first use), a wick husk.

rooms.name: The Old Burrow
rooms.note: Optional exam: the old burrback in its den (2x, an earned window, pogo on the brace). A heart-seed behind it. Its back wall is a pit of black water: glide across later to the Drowned Cup and the dark ring. Within reach: the old burrback, the heart-seed, the pit (glide, seen).

rooms.name: The Moss Bed
rooms.note: Dead end: a dry shelf of moss at the Sump's east end, under the Rootfall's spray. The west's rest, two rooms from the claws. Within reach: the bench, a few freed moths resting, a view of the Rootfall coming down.

rooms.name: The West Chimney
rooms.note: Shaft, 8 tall: a hollow sapling with a thorn floor. Claws's first exam: kick up both faces past side doors (the Drip, the Thorn Flue, the Beetle Run's end) to the Triforium and the Lookout. A wick halfway with a hawker on it. Within reach: the wick, the hawker, four side doors, the thorns below.

rooms.name: The Drip
rooms.note: Dead end off the chimney's west face: water drips through a knot, a moon-drop in the pool. Within reach: the drop, a wick-husk, the kick back out over the thorns.

rooms.name: The Thorn Flue
rooms.note: Dead end: a narrow flue lined with thorns. A timed climb: touch the wick at the bottom and it starts a burn, snuff the four wicks up the flue before it spreads. Pays a glow shard. Within reach: the trial, the shard.

rooms.name: The Far Bough
rooms.note: Dead end: the tip of a limb out over the wood's west edge, a glide from the Lookout. A glow shard in an old nest. Within reach: the shard, a wick on the tip, the long view west.

rooms.name: The Lookout
rooms.note: The top of the chimney, out above the canopy: the first full vista, the Steeple's crown east with a web glinting round its light, the mountain under the moon behind. An old cricket here sells nothing: it gives her the map of the Whorl if she has freed 30 moths. Within reach: the map, the cricket, glides to the Far Bough and along the Canopy Road (seen until glide).

rooms.name: The Triforium
rooms.note: Long hall: a gallery along the outside of the beech's west wall, high above the start. The way back east after claws. Two hawkers over a broken stretch, a lantern (2 hits) she flings off across the break, the Wick Garden's ledge below and a drop into the Rootfall. It ends on a ledge high in the Nave. Within reach: the lantern, the hawkers, the drop, the Wick Garden.

rooms.name: The Canopy Road
rooms.note: Long hall on the canopy, glide-only from the Lookout: limb to limb over the Wick Garden and the Triforium, three wicks on the tips, a hawker between. Within reach: three wicks, the hawker, the glides, the Rose Bough ahead.

rooms.name: The Rose Bough
rooms.note: The beech's own crown, dead branches around the Rose. Leaves to cut, the Rood Loft's knot below (sealed from here), a dangler in the fork. Within reach: the dangler, leaves, the High Canopy east.

rooms.name: The High Canopy
rooms.note: Long hall east toward the Steeple's crown, its light ahead the whole way. A lantern line (fling, fling, glide) and the Rose's knothole to drop through. Its east end meets the Crown, sealed by silk until the Weaver dies (then the way home). Within reach: the lantern line, the drop into the Rose, a hawker.

rooms.name: The East Stair
rooms.note: Shaft: roots stepping down the beech's east side. At its foot, the Gulf: the thorns below, and across it the Steeple's foot with its four-cup door (seen at minute 2, crossed at minute 15). Within reach: a burrback on the stair's landing, the Weave's mouth up a face (claws), the Gulf's edge (glide).

rooms.name: The East Gallery
rooms.note: Long hall: the beech's great east limb, broken off inside the Nave (glide across the vault to reach it) and running out to the Steeple's side door, sealed from the Steeple. Hawkers around a lantern midway. Within reach: the lantern, the hawkers, the Comb below, the Hawk's Notch above (claws), the Steeple door.

rooms.name: The Weave
rooms.note: An orb web across a hollow beside the stair, a moon-drop stuck in its middle: cut a path in without being Caught, a dangler guarding the hub. The Weaver's lesson, small. Its east wall is the Steeple's (the Sap Cup, sealed). Within reach: the web, the dangler, the drop, a wick in the web's frame.

rooms.name: The Comb
rooms.note: A slot down from the East Gallery into the Weave's top: a wick in it, and a one-way drop into the web. Within reach: the wick, the drop, the web below.

rooms.name: The Hawk's Notch
rooms.note: Dead end above the East Gallery, claws up a broken face: where the hawkers roost. A glow shard. Within reach: the shard, a roosting hawker (it wakes if she is lit), a wick.

rooms.name: The Sap Cup
rooms.note: An alcove in the Steeple's west wall, amber sap with an insect caught in it. Its back is the Weave: cut through from here and it is a shortcut home (Steeple to Weave to East Stair to Nave). Within reach: the sap, the cut, a wick.

rooms.name: The Undercroft
rooms.note: Under the start. The floor knot drops her into the root hollow beneath the Hatching (no way back up). Moonlight leaks down from a crack below; a dangler over the landing. Its east end opens over the Gulf (glide). Within reach: the dangler, two wicks on root knuckles, the Moonwell below, the Gulf's edge.

rooms.name: The Moonwell
rooms.note: Dead end straight under the start, the deepest point: a shaft of real moonlight falls all the way down a crack to a pool. She stands in it and her wings dry. GLIDE. The Undercroft is left only by gliding east over the Gulf. Within reach: the glide, the pool, the moonlight.

rooms.name: The Gulf
rooms.note: Set piece: the sinkhole east of the beech, thorns on its floor, the Steeple's foot rising out of the far side with its door of four cups. The first big glide: off the Undercroft, through a hanging lantern's pull (fling or glide past), to the stair or the Steeple's ledge. Within reach: the lantern, two hawkers, the four-cup door, the Thorn Cradle below, the stair.

rooms.name: The Thorn Cradle
rooms.note: Under the Gulf's thorns, a gap only a controlled glide drops into: a moon-drop in a cradle of briar. Its floor leads down to the Drowned Roots. Within reach: the drop, the thorns, a dangler, the dark way west.

rooms.name: The Drowned Cup
rooms.note: A cup of root over the black water behind the Old Burrow, a moon-drop on its lip. The start of the Black Roots, the dark way east. Within reach: the drop, a dangler over the lip, the way down.

rooms.name: The Black Roots
rooms.note: Long hall: the dark way, under the Moonwell. No lamps, so nothing hunts her; glow-worm threads to cut, a slow crawl. Within reach: glow-worm threads, the Drowned Cup, the Drowned Roots.

rooms.name: The Drowned Roots
rooms.note: Long hall, flooded roots under the start and the Gulf: a lantern under water-light with a burrback asleep in its pool (wake it or slip past in the dark). Within reach: the lantern, the burrback, the Grotto below (claws), the Thorn Cradle.

rooms.name: The Glow-worm Grotto
rooms.note: Dead end, claws down a face: a quiet grotto of glow-worms (a light that does not pull), a bench, a few freed moths resting. The bottom ring's rest. Within reach: the bench, glow-worms, the faces back up.

rooms.name: The Steeple
rooms.note: The area's set-piece shaft, 9 tall: a lightning-struck dead pine, hollow, its walls lined with more silk the higher she goes. The firefly flees up ahead of her, relighting wicks as it goes, so the climb is a chase that she snuffs on the way (claws faces, flings, a glide across the hollow). Side doors: the Briar Walk, the Sap Cup, the East Gallery (cut open from here), the Resin Nook. Within reach at every height: a wick, a dangler or a hawker, a side door.

rooms.name: The Resin Nook
rooms.note: Dead end: a dry pocket in the Steeple's east wall just below the crown, the rest before the boss. Within reach: the bench, the silk overhead, the Weaver's shadow passing above.

rooms.name: The Briar Walk
rooms.note: Hall east out of the Steeple: a briar tunnel, a dangler over each gap, a burrback on the far floor. Within reach: the burrback, the danglers, the Hawkers' Ring, the Cache's ledge (claws).

rooms.name: The Hawkers' Ring
rooms.note: Dead end, optional challenge: a ring of three lanterns round a thorn pit, hawkers hunting the orbit; fling round the ring snuffing them, never touching down. Pays a heart-seed. Within reach: three lanterns, two hawkers, the heart-seed.

rooms.name: The Firefly's Cache
rooms.note: Dead end: where the firefly hoards what glows (shells, glass, dew), a glow shard among them, and its signal scratched on the wall (three short, one long). Within reach: the shard, the hoard, a wick.

rooms.name: The Crown
rooms.note: BOSS: the Weaver (lab-weaver). The Steeple's top, open to the sky: the orb web across it round the firefly's lamp-heart, ring flames, hanging columns, the moths caught in it. After it dies the silk to the High Canopy falls (the way home over the Nave).

rooms.name: The Canopy Edge
rooms.note: Exit: above the canopy, every freed moth spirals up past her toward the moon; the valley of lamps below, the mountain bigger than at the hatching. The long glide out.
